messages:
mike_w: Nightdash alert: p95 latency for small-text gen spiked ~2.1x since 03:00 UTC. Affected: us-west, model=rwd-v2-small-quant. Looks correlated with merge #3872 (kernel selector heuristic).

ashley: link to graph? :eyes:

mike_w: https://dash.local/n/nightly/abcdef
p95 pre-merge ~42ms -> now ~93ms
p99 220ms -> 560ms
throughput unchanged

lee_h: kv cache miss rate jumped?
```
kv_cache.miss_rate: 0.04 -> 0.28
cache_evictions/s: +3.2
``` 

sara_k: I profiled a canary pod, seeing lots of kernel fallbacks and frequent kernel selector decisions after sustained temp rise. Perf stack shows frequent switch to fallback-kernel.
```
perf top -p <pid>
# many calls to select_fallback_kernel()
``` 

jonathan_r: fwiw CI perf run flagged this too on merge 3872 (job perf/regression). ci-bot, do we have job id?

ci-bot: CI: perf/regression failed on commit abc123 (merge 3872). p95 regressed 1.8x in batcher_latency test. job: https://ci.local/job/9876

priya_m: that's my PR. I tuned kernel selector to prefer low-power kernel when GPU temp > 73C to reduce flakiness. threshold may be too low on newer cards; didn't expect this KV interplay.

ashley: can we bisect/revert on canary quickly? block rollout until confirmed.

mike_w: reverting canary to 3869 now.

deploy-bot: revert deploy requested: rollback to 3869 in canary. ETA ~2m.

mike_w: reverted canary at 03:22 UTC - https://deploy.local/rollbacks/555

mike_w: metrics now: p95 ~46ms p99 ~235ms, kv_cache.miss_rate back to 0.05

sara_k: ok hold rollout. Priya please open a follow-up to adjust threshold per GPU model and add CI perf test for small-text p95 on rwd-v2-small-quant.

priya_m: will open PR. Also adding telemetry: kernel_choice, gpu_temp, kv_miss to time-series.

ashley: plan: (1) rollout hold (2) revert PR merged to main (done) (3) new PR with per-card thresholds + unit test (4) CI perf test added. :white_check_mark:
